definitions.b: receiver's drive error before the act minus after it, plus the drop it could take by eating/drinking a food or drink it was given
definitions.c: giver's error after minus before, plus the use it loses by giving food/drink away, plus the error its needs grow by during the act's turns (upper bound)
definitions.q: a third party in the room saw the act, or was told of it that night
definitions.q_eff: a third party's liking of the giver moved in the deed's direction (on seeing it or being told)
definitions.w_same: the pair is in one room again later that night; w_next: at some time the next night
